en: A sepia-toned image showing a narrow street lined with old stone and plaster buildings, some with open wooden doors and hanging goods. The street curves gently to the right, passing under a stone archway. In the foreground, there is a person with a cart and another figure standing by the street. In the background, hills and more buildings are visible. The caption at the bottom reads: '5 - CAMPRODÓN. Carrer de St. Roch'.
